description:
A bison in Yellowstone eats nothing but grass, and it is still the animal the park's own records worry about most. Doug spends one Yellowstone year with the American bison, from winter wolf hunts that need a dozen wolves, through calving season and 55 km/h sprints, to the August rut, where two bulls fight head to head.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
